instructions.content: NEVER create entries without reading the complete template schema first.
NEVER proceed with failed validation; fix the errors and re-run validation until it passes before committing.
NEVER use bare code blocks; ALWAYS give fenced code blocks a language specifier.
NEVER create date mismatches: the filename date, frontmatter date and H1 date must match exactly.
The filename is YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md with a lowercase-only, hyphenated slug of 3-6 meaningful keywords.
Place the file in YYYY/MM-Month/DD-Weekday/ matching its date.
Use exactly ONE H1 in the format '# [Title] - [Month D, YYYY]'.
Frontmatter tags must match the final Tags section exactly.
Tags are lowercase with hyphens, not underscores or camelCase.
Include the entry type tag when required (troubleshooting, learning, article/video/podcast/talk, ticket-refinement, ticket-kickoff).
NEVER use emojis outside fenced code blocks; use a bold status word instead.
Create the metadata block with bold keys.
Follow the four phases: interactive gathering, schema loading, generation, validation and formatting.
Default to the current date unless the user specifies otherwise.
If the file already exists, ask to overwrite or suggest an alternative filename; never overwrite without confirmation.
Select the entry type from the user's intent: problem resolution to Troubleshooting, new knowledge to Learning, external content to Article Summary, otherwise General.
After validation passes, format with prettier, lint with the repo's markdown linter with --fix, then re-validate.
If a schema file is missing or unreadable, STOP and report the error; do not guess the structure.
For troubleshooting with a Jira ticket, prefix the slug with the lowercase ticket key once: YYYY-MM-DD-proj-1234-slug.md.
NEVER post a Jira comment draft or create a ticket-linked entry without one: set jira_ticket and add a self-contained '## Jira Comment Draft' with a 'review before posting; not yet posted' banner.
NEVER edit the ticket directly when refining it: set refinement_ticket and put the amended description in a fenced block under '## Proposed Ticket Description'.
For ticket kickoff set kickoff_ticket and fill all five required sections; never leave Open Questions & Gaps blank (write 'None identified').
For multi-day work, create a new dated entry linked both ways with continues_from and continued_by; never fold a later day's narrative into an earlier entry.
NEVER place the Executive Summary anywhere other than the H2 immediately after '## Session Overview'.
Store screenshots and attachments in an entry-specific sibling directory YYYY-MM-DD-slug/assets/ and reference them by relative path.
When intent is ambiguous prefer the more specific type: Troubleshooting > Ticket Refinement > Ticket Kickoff > Learning > General.
Confirm the pantheon-journal binary is present before any CLI-backed step, and skip those steps if it is missing while the self-contained workflow still applies.
Prefer canonical tags from the taxonomy facets and canonical spellings over aliases; treat lint output as advisory.
Do not use the skill for quick notes without frontmatter, external documentation systems such as Confluence or Notion, or bulk backfilling of old entries.
Load compliance.md only if validation fails and detailed rules are needed.
Commit messages use the format 'Add journal entry: [Brief Description] (YYYY-MM-DD)', offered only after validation passes.
